shared_values: A Formula 1 team tests its ideas in simulation before it builds a part. COMSOL makes the software that lets engineers model how heat, airflow, structures and electromagnetics act together before they build anything.
flags: Motorsport signal: on 7 Oct 2026 COMSOL was named Official Multiphysics Partner of the ABB FIA Formula E World Championship (multi-year; announced at the COMSOL Conference in Boston). Part of the budget is committed there and the Formula E contract may limit other motorsport deals; ask on the first call. The email does not mention Formula E.

target_audience: Your target customers are the communications and risk leaders of large companies in professional services, technology, automotive and drinks, and leaders from each are in Formula 1: Deloitte (McLaren), NetApp (Aston Martin), Meta AI (Mercedes), Honda (Aston Martin) and Heineken (Red Bull). Teams also introduce partners to each other, to their owners and boards, and run joint activations at forums like Davos and Cannes Lions.

market_reference: Medallia, the closest peer on the grid in software that tells leaders what people think of their organisation, has been McLaren's Official Feedback Partner since 2021. The team uses it to capture feedback from fans and staff, and Medallia's brand went on the rear wing and the pit crew helmets from the 2022 season.
shared_values: A Formula 1 team reads live data from the car and acts before a small problem costs a race. Signal AI reads millions of news articles a day so leaders can act on a reputation risk before it grows.
